Not exactly-once: same-UUID repeated death lacks killed guard; no atomic feature acknowledgement.

Primary codec resultOrPartial fallback DEFAULT when no result; exact DFU partial semantics not deep read. Optional fields absent default but explicit invalid/duplicate gateway IDs not clamped. UUID/current root can be valid but point to unavailable entity. saveData sets isRespawningfalse unconditionally. No phase/time/crystal references saved; EndCrystal beam target separately persists, potentially visual residue untested. Constructor can read external legacy true but starts START and null crystal list; tick sets stage null then tryRespawn and unconditionally dereferences stage after, if not rearmed may be null. Do not repeat comment-based allarena-loaded claims or claim customorigin supported everywhere. createNewDragon ignores addFreshEntity boolean then storesUUID, placement ignores spawn acknowledgement then shrinksitem. Gateway pop occurs before registry optional feature placement, no refund/ack; firstegg setBlock result ignored. No atomic world/entity/item/metadata save guarantee. setDragonKilled only checks UUID, not previous dragonKilled guard; repeated same-UUID call can consume another gateway, although egg protected by previouslyKilled. Actual normal kill/tickDeath paths read but no claim repeated sequence tested. XP native Forge hooks can modify award, no economic promise all players get literal amounts. World firstkill/global gateway pool is not per-player earned rank or quest Clone whitelist. No acknowledgement ensures crystal exists; external legacy IsRespawning=true can trigger null crystal paths. No proof all four-item payment/refund safety. setDragonKilled stores previouslyKilled after gateway placement; repeated same UUID consumes another gateway because no dragonKilled guard. Feature absent/failure loses popped entitlement; restore must not be described exactly-once reward logic.
